result.summary: Several layout and content truncation issues are visible: restaurant names and category chips are cut off, and the bottom promotional card is partially obscured by the navigation bar.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' and delivery info may also be clipped, while only part of the card is visible at the edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll cards fully display titles (e.g. ellipsis with full name on detail, or wrap) and show enough of the next card without cutting critical text.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card is partially covered by the fixed bottom tab bar, hiding part of the image and content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so the last cards clear the tab bar.

issues.description: The category filter chips row is cut off on the right (partial chip visible after 'Healthy'), with no clear affordance that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Indicate horizontal scroll (fade, peek of next chip, or scroll indicators) and avoid clipping chip labels awkwardly.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' appears to lose the final letter ('Ramen' vs expected full spelling) or sits awkwardly near the rating.
issues.suggestion: Verify full restaurant names render completely and spacing with the rating badge does not cause truncation.
